name: example_3_surface
what_it_shows: A calendar event near a saved place: the Context Agent matches, the Critic approves a reminder with its evidence.
curl: curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"synthetic": true, "events": [{"context_type": "CALENDAR", "title": "Dinner with Alex", "occurs_at": "2026-10-26T20:00:00+11:00", "location_name": "Fitzroy North", "city": "Melbourne", "country": "Australia"}]}' http://localhost:8000/api/context/evaluate
